pattern.short_summary: A procedure defined over two or more roles is run by one person alone, with the model filling every role but theirs.
pattern.definition: A procedure defined over two or more roles is run by one person alone, with the model filling every role but theirs. The scheduling and co-presence requirements disappear; the activity becomes asynchronous and single-user. The interaction retains the shape of the multi-party original.
pattern.structural_signature: The system takes a procedure defined over n≥2 human participants and reassigns all roles but one to the model, leaving a single-user loop that runs at the remaining participant's own pace. Structurally: role count unchanged, human count reduced to one, synchronization constraint removed. Observable in the paper as a mapping from the multi-party procedure's roles onto the agent's behaviours. Transplants to pair programming, moderated review, negotiation practice, peer critique.

dimension.category_description: How human and artificial participants are personified, assigned visible roles, coordinated, simulated, or represented to one another.
dimension.classification_boundary: Identity or social organization must be user-facing; invisible multi-agent division of labor is excluded.
